spellbook.finance/limitations: Preparation grants no consent and changes no marketplace price or automation mode.
The owner may explicitly choose manual automation in the web app to support a quiet interval. Manual also pauses automatic listing; fulfillment, sales, quantity and withdrawal continue.
Account coverage requires complete discovery. Exclusions and invalid or missing evidence remain visible; a pending enrollment does not replace active limits.

description: Prepare an account-wide enrollment proposal from explicit owner-selected bounds and times. Returns a durable header and coverage counts. Explain the quiet interval prerequisite before calling: controlled price admissions and relevant membership changes can invalidate discovery. Continue with spellbook_ebay_price_limit_enrollment_continue; the owner reviews and activates in the web app.

decreaseCents.description: Owner-selected absolute USD cents below each observed baseline. Required; no default.

endsAt.description: Owner-selected exclusive admission-window end as a UTC timestamp. Required.

increaseCents.description: Owner-selected absolute USD cents above each observed baseline. Required; no default.

scope.description: Known ordinary live USD listings for the verified eBay account. Required.

startsAt.description: Owner-selected inclusive admission-window start as a UTC timestamp. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_price_limit_enrollment_prepare
